conclusion: 今日主线不是 Astra 又多了几个入口，而是三个默认行为在 24 小时内发生了实质变化: Codex 0.153.4 已把 Astra 放进 bundled model picker，并在未显式配置模型时设为 bundled default；GitHub Copilot 的 Astra GA 默认随新模型策略自动启用，除非管理员关闭全局默认或显式禁用；Copilot CLI 1.0.84-0 则允许用户在批准一次 bypass 后，为本次会话关闭 managed sandbox。与此同时，HydraFusion 开始把单模型、级联、独立评审三种路线交给运行时选择，VS Code Agent Merge 也开始循环处理 review、失败检查和冲突。
excerpt: 2026-09-06 的重点是默认模型漂移、会话级 sandbox bypass、多模型路由小票和 Agent Merge 停止条件。
今天的判断很明确: 默认模型要点名验收，临时门禁要按时收回，多模型总包要分项记账，自动返工要先画停止线。

signals.title: Codex 0.153.4 makes Astra visible and bundled-default
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: Codex changed Astra from API-configurable but hidden in 0.153.1 to visible in the bundled model picker and the bundled default when no model is explicitly configured.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Record requested and actual model, client version, default source, and rollback value for every new or resumed session.

signals.title: Codex 0.153.3 adds Astra to Amazon Bedrock catalogs
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: Astra entered Mantle and Runtime global and US Bedrock routes, while async-question guidance was corrected to match the available text-only tool.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Validate each provider route separately and only invoke asynchronous clarification when the session exposes the supported tool.

signals.title: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Astra reaches IDE, CLI, coding agent, app, web, and mobile surfaces, and new models are enabled automatically unless administrators change the default policy or disable the model.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use an explicit team model allowlist and read back model availability on each surface instead of treating GA as synchronized rollout.

signals.title: Project HydraFusion introduces runtime multi-model orchestration
signals.author: GitHub
signals.summary: HydraFusion chooses single, cascade, or critique workflows and documents complete accounting, bounded execution, isolated review, fail-safe patches, and validated routing.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Create a route receipt for every workflow leg, including role, model, tools, timeout, cost, result, retry, and fallback.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.84-0 adds session-wide sandbox bypass
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: An approved bypass prompt can disable managed sandboxing for the rest of the session, and the release fixes repository-account selection when several GitHub accounts exist.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat session-wide bypass as an expiring privileged lease and read back sandbox plus account identity after approval.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.84-1 adds Astra support
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: The CLI receives explicit Astra support shortly after the model becomes broadly available across Copilot surfaces.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Pin the CLI version in reproducible trials and verify the actual model after rollout rather than relying on catalog announcements.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.83 stabilizes model policy, identity, MCP, and sandbox controls
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: The stable release combines ordered model fallback, required model policy, MCP OAuth CIMD, organization-pinned sign-in, repository-aware gh identity, and sandbox controls.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use 1.0.83 as a governance checklist covering model list, identity binding, MCP policy readiness, network boundary, and resume behavior.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - August 31
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: The weekly rollup combines content exclusions with VS Code Agent Merge, multi-root workspaces, hierarchical chat sessions, and attention states.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Track exclusions, primary workspace, pending approvals, and merge-loop stop conditions as one session control record.

signals.title: Visual Studio Code 1.136 expands agent sessions and Agent Merge
signals.author: Microsoft / VS Code
signals.summary: Agent Merge repeatedly addresses review feedback, failed checks, and conflicts; multi-root sessions expand agent work while hooks still resolve from a selected primary folder.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Set maximum rounds, budget, allowed paths, CI retry limits, and the primary hook folder before enabling merge loops.

signals.title: GitHub adds a privacy-safe repository star history API
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: The endpoint exposes historical star counts and timestamps without revealing individual stargazer identities, replacing a privacy-sensitive collection path.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use aggregate trend endpoints for tool scouting and keep individual account identities out of the research dataset.

signals.title: OpenAI Node SDK 7.10.0 adds Astra API types and a canonical security model
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The SDK release adds Astra-related API support and documents a canonical SDK security model, separating integration contracts from launch messaging.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Upgrade SDKs only after checking generated types, endpoints, security assumptions, and rollback in a fixed integration test.

signals.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers
signals.author: OpenAI
signals.summary: The official video description highlights computer use, creative and knowledge work, asynchronous tool calling, and steering in the Responses API.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Prototype async tools with explicit progress, cancellation, user-input, and final state-readback contracts.

signals.title: GPT-6 Astra with Ben Davis
signals.author: OpenAI
signals.summary: The official description says parallel research branches helped test theories and stay on track on difficult puzzle tasks.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use parallel branches only for independent hypotheses, then require one coordinator to reconcile contradictions and verify the final claim.

signals.title: GitWarren
signals.author: Michal Wrzosek / Product Hunt
signals.summary: The public Product Hunt feed describes a workflow for reviewing code with coding agents before committing, which fits a local quality-gate candidate pool.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Before trial, inspect repository access, data retention, write behavior, diff scope, and whether review remains local and read-only.

signals.title: Experiential Labs
signals.author: Product Hunt
signals.summary: The feed describes an open-source AI gateway that uses traffic to improve model behavior, raising useful routing and data-governance questions.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Require source-code, telemetry, retention, opt-out, eval, and rollback review before sending any real traffic.

signals.title: TrackMCP
signals.author: Krishna Goyal / Product Hunt
signals.summary: The feed positions TrackMCP as analytics for MCP servers, making it a candidate for tool-call volume, latency, and failure visibility.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Evaluate with synthetic traffic first and verify payload redaction, identity handling, retention, and self-hosting boundaries.

knowledge.title: Default Model Drift Receipt
knowledge.label: MODEL GOVERNANCE
knowledge.body: 记录期望模型、实际模型、默认来源和回滚值，防止 hotfix 或管理员策略静默改变执行者。
knowledge.summary: 每次会话同时记录期望模型和实际模型，把默认值变化当成配置发布。
steps: 记录客户端版本、入口、请求模型、实际模型、默认来源和管理员策略。
升级前后各跑一组固定任务，并读回 model 和 reasoning 字段。
发现未授权漂移时恢复固定模型并暂停推广。
knowledge.risk: 只看 release headline 会漏掉 hotfix 中的默认值变化。

knowledge.title: Session Sandbox Bypass Receipt
knowledge.label: PRIVILEGED SESSION
knowledge.body: 把整场会话的 sandbox bypass 当成有范围、有到期点、可撤销的临时高权限租约。
knowledge.summary: 把本会话关闭 sandbox 当成临时高权限租约，而不是普通确认框。
steps: 记录发起原因、批准人、目录、网络、账号、开始时间和自动到期点。
每个高风险动作后读回 sandbox 与身份状态。
任务完成或范围变化时立即恢复默认隔离。
knowledge.risk: 一次 bypass 可能影响后续整个会话，而用户仍以为只是单条命令。

knowledge.title: Compound Model Route Receipt
knowledge.label: MULTI-MODEL
knowledge.body: 逐段记录 draft、critique、revision、cascade 的模型、权限、耗时、成本、结果与 fallback。
knowledge.summary: 多模型不是一个黑盒名字，而是一串可审计的 draft、critique、revision 和 cascade 路段。
steps: 每段记录 role、model、reasoning、tool scope、timeout、cost、result 和 fallback。
critic 保持只读无工具，writer 串行修改共享状态。
失败、取消或未过 gate 时不应用 patch。
knowledge.risk: 只记最终模型会漏掉真正消耗成本或影响结论的中间调用。

knowledge.title: Agent Merge Stop Contract
knowledge.label: MERGE LOOP
knowledge.body: 循环修复前固定最大轮次、预算、允许路径和 CI 重跑次数，范围扩大时交回人工。
knowledge.summary: 给循环修到可合并的 agent 预先设置停止线。
steps: 固定最大轮次、预算、允许路径、CI 重跑次数和禁止变更。
每轮保存问题、改动、测试与剩余失败。
范围扩大、同错重复或需高风险权限时停给人工。
knowledge.risk: 没有停止线时，agent 可能为了变绿持续扩大改动。

knowledge.title: MCP Identity and Account Binding Gate
knowledge.label: IDENTITY
knowledge.body: 验证 MCP client、组织、仓库和实际账号的绑定，避免多账号环境下认证成功却身份错误。
knowledge.summary: MCP 与 CLI 不只要能登录，还要证明使用了哪个 client、组织和账号。
steps: 记录 client metadata、server、organization、repository 与实际账号。
连接前等管理员 allow/deny 策略完成，禁止抢跑启动。
执行后读回账号与资源范围，发现错绑立即停止。
knowledge.risk: credential store 中有多个账号时，成功认证不等于身份正确。
